The Name "C++"

Rick Mascitti coins the name C++ (increment operator). Virtual table dispatch introduced.

Virtual Functions const specifier Op Overloading

C++11 STABILIZED

Smart Pointers & RAII

Replaces error-prone manual memory allocation with deterministic lifetime tracking: unique_ptr for single ownership and shared_ptr with thread-safe atomic reference counting.

C++20 BREAKTHROUGH

Concepts & Constraints

Eliminates cryptic multi-page template compiler diagnostics. Constrains template types with expressive compile-time predicates, delivering instant comprehensible compiler error messages.

Type Verification: Compile-Time
Generic Type T
▶
requires Integral
Diagnostic Clarity: 10x Zero SFINAE
C++20 EVOLUTION

C++ Modules (import std;)

Ends 40 years of textual macro `#include` duplication. Translates translation units into isolated pre-compiled binary AST units, dramatically slashing compile times.

Header Text Expansion: 100K LOC / file
Module Binary Unit: 1x AST Load
Macro Leakage: 0% Linear Scaling
C++20 EXPRESSIVENESS

Ranges & Pipeline Views

Compose transformations via Unix-like pipe operator `|`. Lazy evaluation ensures elements are computed strictly on-demand with zero intermediate allocation buffers.

Data Source | filter(even) | take(5)
Evaluation Mode: Lazy Zero Allocations
C++11 / C++14

Lambdas & Generic Closures

First-class anonymous function objects with explicit capture modes: value copy, mutable state, reference borrowing, or move semantics with zero function-pointer indirection overhead.

[ & ] Ref
[ = ] Copy
[x=move] Move
Inline Optimization: 100% Functor Synthesized
C++11 / C++20

Compile-Time Evaluation

Shift massive computing workloads from user devices to compile time. `consteval` guarantees zero runtime clock cycles by emitting precomputed constants directly into program binaries.

Compilation Phase: Calculation Done
Target Executable: 0 CPU Cycles
Binary Load Cost: Static ROM Pure Constant
